text:
olga-support: FYI customer Horizon (acct: horizon-inc) reporting repeated 5xxs on /v1/rerank when they run nightly bulk scoring. They see p95 jump from ~120ms to 2.4s and a bunch of 502/504 gateway timeouts. Customer says retries racked up and pushed them over quota :confused:

kevin-sre: can you paste the raw request they used and approximate qps? also any correlation id or trace id from the gateway?

olga-support: sample payload they provided (trimmed):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/rerank-v2",
  "candidates": [ /* ~1.2k candidates */ ],
  "query": "...",
  "top_k": 10
}
```
They said they send 5 concurrent jobs (cron) overnight ~30s apart; each job fans out -> single rerank call with huge candidate array. Trace id: gtw-20240321-9f3b (attached in ticket).

jess-eng: that candidate list size is huge. Rerank optimization assumes candidate <= 200 typically. With 1.2k we likely trigger batching/copy overhead + KV cache pressure. Which backend model variant? redwood/rerank-v2-32k?

olga-support: they set model to redwood/rerank-v2, default config. No custom quantization.

sre-bot: alert: gateway-gtw-prod high 504 rate (last 15m) - groups: rerank, bulk-calls, gateway-throttle.

kevin-sre: reproducing locally: try a synthetic job with candidates=1200, concurrency=5, qps ~0.2 per job. If we can repro, we'll capture logs and KV cache metrics. Sam, can you coordinate with Horizon to run a controlled repro with lower blast window?

sam-support: reached out to Horizon to schedule controlled repro for 2am PST. Asked them to include an API key we can use to repro or to whitelist our test key. They also flagged billing — they claim retries counted as billable tokens and want a credit if we confirm a platform-side retry loop.

ana-platform: suggested mitigations while we triage: 1) advise customer to slice candidate lists into smaller calls (<=200). 2) temporary client-side concurrency limit to 1 per account to avoid fanning. 3) enable gateway-level circuit breaker for rerank route to fail fast instead of piling up retries. 4) add immediate 429 backoff header to encourage exponential backoff. I'll draft a quick KB message.

ben-ops: on infra side we can turn on an emergency request-size limiter for /v1/rerank (reject >512k payloads), and lower connection pool keepalive for large jobs. That should reduce queue pressure. Do we want to do that now or only if repro shows backend saturation?

kevin-sre: let's try non-invasive things first: 1) repro in sandbox and capture kernel /gpu metrics, 2) ask runtime to enable kvcache-prefetch=false for the model in sandbox to see if prefetching causes thrash, 3) run a flamegraph during repro. If we see GC/alloc spikes, escalate to eng-runtime.

jess-eng: additional theory: the fanout -> many large token sequences might create long-lived KV caches that kill memory on the host and cause timeouts, or cause intermittent 5xx when a shard OOMs and falls back. Also if clients retry aggressively, we can get retry amplification. Recommend adding guidance: use chunked rerank (score smaller groups and merge), or use streaming ranker endpoints.

olga-support: customer asked if auth might be an issue because some calls succeed while others 502. They rotated keys and still see flapping.

kevin-sre: auth is unlikely here given mixed success; gateway logs show 200 then a cluster of 502/504 with backend error codes under load. Still capture auth logs but deprioritize.

sam-support: on billing: ticket# 2026-987 — I've flagged for credits if we confirm platform retry loop. Finance notified.

ana-platform: I pushed a docs blurb to internal KB with suggested client mitigations. Will include code sample for splitting candidates: 
```js
// naive chunker
function chunk(arr, size){ const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i+=size) out.push(arr.slice(i,i+size)); return out; }
// call /v1/rerank for each chunk and merge top K client-side
```

kevin-sre: repro result (sandbox run): with 1200 candidates x5 concurrency we reproduced p95~2.1s and backend node CPU peaked 94%, GC pauses visible, and several worker processes restarted (OOM-killed) -> 502s. KV cache prefetch=true increased memory pressure. Turning prefetch off reduced OOMs but still high latency.

jess-eng: escalation needed -> ENG-RUNTIME to investigate mem accounting, prefetch heuristics, and a safe server-side cap for candidates. Opening ENG issue and pinging @eng-runtime. Attach trace IDs: gtw-20240321-9f3b, sandbox-274321-test1.

olga-support: communicated interim mitigations to Horizon: 1) slice candidate list to <=200, 2) set concurrency to 1 for nightly job, 3) we will review billing after root cause. They accepted temporary changes.

ben-ops: implemented temporary gateway reject for payloads >512k and enabled short circuit for >10 concurrent rerank requests per account. Monitoring for collateral.

kevin-sre: next steps: - ENG-RUNTIME to triage memory GC/kvcache prefetch path (owner: jess-eng) - Product/Platform consider server-side candidate soft limit + helpful 413/429 guidance - Support to handle billing credit request (ticket 2026-987) - Ops to monitor for new 5xx regressions

olga-support: assigning owner: kevin-sre. I'll update Horizon in the morning with repro notes and timeline. Thanks all :heart:

sam-support: closing loop in ticket after ENG issue created.
